title: Objectwise counit factorization through an epic tensor unit
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $A=f_*\mathcal O_U$, $\rho:\mathcal O_X\to A$ the structure map, $R$ pushforward of modules to A-module sheaves and $S$ restriction along $\rho$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $I=f^{-1}$ on A-modules and $IA=f^{-1}A$, $r_0:f^{-1}\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_U$ for the structure map, $t_0=f^{-1}\rho$, and $e:IA\to\mathcal O_U$ for the ring-sheaf counit. Let $b:\mathcal O_U\to B$ and $t:IA\to B$ form a pushout of $r_0,t_0$, and let $\epsilon:B\to\mathcal O_U$ satisfy $b\epsilon=1$ and $t\epsilon=e$. Let $P$ be a functor from A-module sheaves to B-module sheaves, with specified identifications $P(G)=B\otimes_{IA}I(G)$ and map $P(a)$ the transported sheafification of $1\otimes I(a)$. Let $\kappa:P\operatorname{Res}_b\simeq S f^*$ be a natural isomorphism, where $f^*$ is tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $H$ be a functor to $\mathcal O_U$-modules, with specified identifications $H(G)=\mathcal O_U\otimes_B P(G)$ and map $H(a)$ the transported sheafification of $1\otimes P(a)$. Let $\gamma:S f^*\to H$ be natural. All tensor products here have the scalar factor first and are sheafified [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $\theta_t,\theta_\epsilon$ denote their sheafification units and $\eta^{\mathrm{ab}}$ the inverse-image/direct-image unit on underlying abelian sheaves. For every open $V$ of X and section $g\in G(V)$ assume, after the specified object identifications, $\kappa_G^{-1}(\eta^{f^*}_{SG,V}(g))=\theta_t(1\otimes\eta^{\mathrm{ab}}_{G,V}(g))$ over $f^{-1}V$, where $\eta^{f^*}$ is the unit of the canonical adjunction of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For every open W of U and $p\in P(G)(W)$ assume $\gamma_G(\kappa_G(p))=\theta_\epsilon(1\otimes p)$. Then for every $\mathcal O_U$-module F there exists an $\mathcal O_U$-linear map $a_F:H(RF)\to F$ with $\gamma_{RF}a_F$ equal to the counit of that canonical pullback adjunction, and $\gamma_{RF}$ is an epimorphism.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01SB (lemma-affine-equivalence-modules), construction of h and elucidation

proof.text: Use the counit-linearity lemma to obtain delta:P(RF) to Res_epsilon F, with the section formula counit after kappa.

Use the change-of-rings adjunction along epsilon. Its inverse Hom equivalence sends delta to a map from the explicit tensor sheaf to F. Transport along hobj defines a_F. The adjunction section formula and hH show gamma a_F=counit after precomposing with the isomorphism kappa; cancel that isomorphism.

For any two maps out of H(RF) whose composites with gamma agree, transport them to maps from the explicit tensor sheaf. Apply the injective change-of-rings Hom equivalence. Its section formula evaluates them on theta_epsilon(1 tensor p), which hH identifies with gamma(kappa(p)) after transport. The assumed equality of composites gives equality on every p, hence equality of the adjuncts and the original maps. This proves Epi gamma directly, without a local-surjectivity argument.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof uses counit B-linearity and the change-of-rings Hom equivalence. Epimorphy follows directly by injectivity of that equivalence.

theorem affine_module_tensor_counitFactor
    (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u}) (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B) (t : IA ⟶ B)
    (ε : B ⟶ U.sheaf) (hpush : IsPushout r₀ t₀ b t)
    (hb : b ≫ ε = 𝟙 U.sheaf) (ht : t ≫ ε = e₀)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B))
        (pobj : ∀ G, P.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} t (I G))
        (κ : P ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 b) ≅ S ⋙ tensorPullback f)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ U.Modules)
          (hobj : ∀ G, H.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))
          (γ : S ⋙ tensorPullback f ⟶ H)
    (hP :
        (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
          P.map a = eqToHom (pobj G) ≫
            SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} t (I G)
              (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap f.base A G a) ≫
            eqToHom (pobj G').symm) ∧
        (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ) (g : G.val.obj V),
          ((eqToHom (pobj G)).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
            ((κ.inv.app G).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
              (((adj₀).unit.app ((S).obj G)).val.app V g)) =
            ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
              (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} t (I G))).app
                ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
                ((1 : B.obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
                  ⊗ₜ[(IA).obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V),(t.hom.app
                    ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom]
                  (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                    (Opens.map f.base) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (𝓙 X) (𝓙 U)).unit.app
                      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (𝓡 A)).obj G)).hom.app V g))))
    (hH :
          (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
            H.map a = eqToHom (hobj G) ≫
              SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G) (P.map a) ≫
              eqToHom (hobj G').symm) ∧
          (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (W : (Opens U)ᵒᵖ)
              (p : (P.obj G).val.obj W),
            ((eqToHom (hobj G)).val.app W)
              ((γ.app G).val.app W ((κ.hom.app G).val.app W p)) =
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 U.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app
                (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))).app W
                  ((1 : U.sheaf.obj.obj W) ⊗ₜ[B.obj.obj W,(ε.hom.app W).hom] p))) :
    ∀ F : U.Modules,
      (∃ a : H.obj ((R).obj F) ⟶ F,
        γ.app ((R).obj F) ≫ a = (adj₀).counit.app F) ∧ Epi (γ.app ((R).obj F))
